title: Solving d-bar globally to construct a holomorphic boundary singularity
statement: For a bounded \(C^\infty\) strongly pseudoconvex domain \(\Omega\subset\mathbb C^n\), solve \(\bar\partial u=\alpha\) with smooth dependence and regularity up to the boundary for every smooth closed \((0,1)\)-form, and use this to construct, at each boundary point, a holomorphic function that does not extend across that point.
status: As of 9 November 2026, this precise strongly pseudoconvex version was already solved before the seminar \citep{kohn1963potential,kohn1963harmonic,kohn1964harmonic}. No claim of a new unresolved Levi problem is made.
